title: Sign in
purpose: Start a session using the account issued by your repository.
summary: Sign in with the account your repository issued.

tasks.title: Sign in with your password
steps: Type your username or email in [[Login]] and your [[Password]].
Check [[Remember me]] to stay signed in after closing the browser.
Select [[Sign in]]. If you have an authenticator app, you are asked for its code next.

tasks.title: Sign in with an emailed code
steps: Select [[Email me a sign-in code]] and enter the email on your account.
Type the code from the email in the same browser within five minutes.

tasks.title: Recover a forgotten password
steps: Select [[Forgot your password?]] and follow the emailed link.

good_to_know: Accounts are issued by the repository. There is no public sign-up.
Notices beside the form come from the repository and are the same for everyone who opens this page.
Failed attempts are rate limited. Your roles decide what you can open after signing in.
The administration site has no separate sign-in: it uses this page and the same second factor.

sections.title: Announcements
paragraphs: Notices from the repository can appear in a box beside the sign-in form on wide screens, or under it on narrower ones, newest first, each marked Notice or Important with a title and a plain-text message. They are shown to anyone who opens this page, before signing in, so they never depend on your account. The repository’s administrators post and withdraw them; nothing appears when none is current. Staff may see further announcements after signing in, on the dashboard.

Beside the form, the box is always the same height as the form. When the notices are longer, scroll inside the box with the mouse or trackpad, or press Tab after the Sign in button to reach the box and use the arrow keys. Under the form the box shows all of its text.
A public demonstration may list shared accounts and their password in an announcement here. Those accounts cannot change their password, email addresses or two-factor settings after signing in.

items.label: Login
items.description: Required username or email address, as the placeholder Username or email explains. Its role assignment controls what the account can open after sign-in.

items.label: Password
items.description: Required account password. Use Forgot your password? beneath this field for the email-based recovery form.

items.label: Remember me
items.description: Optional, initially unchecked. Checked requests the normal persistent session lifetime; unchecked expires the session cookie when the browser session ends. The committed session lifetime is Django’s default two weeks.

items.label: Sign in
items.description: Checks credentials and active account status, then asks for an enrolled second factor when applicable. A valid next destination takes precedence; otherwise sign-in goes to the dashboard.

items.label: Email me a sign-in code
items.description: Opens the email-code request page as an alternative to entering your password. Enter the email on your repository account there, then type the emailed code in the requesting browser within five minutes. This action appears when the deployment uses an email backend other than the disabled dummy backend. Its availability does not confirm successful email delivery. An enrolled second factor is still required when applicable.

sections.title: Enabled behavior
paragraphs: Public sign-up is closed; the repository issues accounts through administration. Username/email password login is enabled and does not require an email code. Passkey login is not offered. Password sign-in permits unverified email, but that does not establish email ownership or satisfy MFA enrollment prerequisites. A successful email-code sign-in verifies the account email. Failed attempts are rate limited. A successful login never adds roles or access. No invitations are sent by this screen.

The administration site has no separate sign-in. Opening it while signed out leads here, so the same failed-attempt limit and enrolled second factor apply, and afterwards returns to the administration page that was requested. An account without Staff status that is already signed in is refused there.
